# Post Analyses for "AI Deactivation Reduces Loneliness and Increases Social Interaction"
We look at the changes between the follow-up survey and the baseline survey

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(mediation)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)
library(stargazer)
library(lavaan)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
```

```{r}
DATA_DIR <- "../data/"

df <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "participant_data.csv"), check.names = TRUE)
df$provide_metadata <- ifelse(tolower(df$provide_metadata) == "true", 1, 0)
df$completed_endline <- ifelse(tolower(df$completed_endline) == "true", 1, 0)
df$completed_post <- ifelse(tolower(df$completed_post) == "true", 1, 0)
```

```{r}
# Collapse the sparse demographic levels that would otherwise be singleton cells.
collapse_levels <- function(x, other, other_label = "Other") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  factor(ifelse(x %in% other, other_label, x))
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_treatment = ifelse(baseline_treatment == "True", 1, 0),
    treatment = as_treatment(baseline_treatment),
    wave      = factor(wave),
    baseline_Gender = collapse_levels(baseline_Gender, c("2", "4")),
    baseline_Race   = collapse_levels(baseline_Race,   c("3", "4", "5", "6", "7")),
    Relationship = factor(
      case_when(
        baseline_Relationship == 0                ~ "Single",
        baseline_Relationship %in% c(1, 2, 3)     ~ "In Relationship",
        baseline_Relationship %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7)  ~ "Other",
        TRUE                                      ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Single", "In Relationship", "Other")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
baseline_stats <- list()
df_z <- df
df_z$log_approvals <- log1p(df$Total.approvals)
df_z$baseline_Usage <- df_z$Usage
dvs <- c("loneliness", "esi", "wb", "BPNSFS_Autonomy", "BPNSFS_Competence", "BPNSFS_Relatedness", "problematic_use", "intensity", "Usage")
z_vars <- setdiff(dvs, c("date_since_start", "is_weekend"))

for (v in z_vars) {
  bcol <- paste0("baseline_", v)
  pcol <- paste0("post_", v)
  if (!all(c(bcol, pcol) %in% names(df)) ||
      !is.numeric(df[[bcol]]) || !is.numeric(df[[pcol]])) next
  mu   <- mean(df[[bcol]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sdev <- sd(df[[bcol]],   na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sdev) || sdev == 0) next        # no usable baseline -> leave raw
  df_z[[bcol]] <- (df[[bcol]] - mu) / sdev
  df_z[[pcol]] <- (df[[pcol]] - mu) / sdev
  baseline_stats[[v]] <- c(mean = mu, sd = sdev, n = sum(!is.na(df[[bcol]])))
}

# reference table: what "1 SD" means for each outcome
baseline_sd_table <- data.frame(
  outcome       = names(baseline_stats),
  baseline_mean = vapply(baseline_stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "mean"),
  baseline_sd   = vapply(baseline_stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "sd"),
  n_baseline    = vapply(baseline_stats, `[[`, numeric(1), "n"),
  row.names     = NULL
)

```


```{r}
person_covs <- c("wave", "baseline_Age", "baseline_Gender", "baseline_Race",
                 "baseline_EdLevel", "baseline_Income", "Relationship",
                 "Tenure", "Usage", "Social", "Productivity")

controls        <- paste(c(person_covs), collapse = " + ")

fit_primary <- function(dv, data = df_z) {
  lm(reformulate(c("baseline_treatment", paste0("baseline_", dv), controls), response =paste0("post_", dv)),
       data = data)
}

fit_usage <- function(dv, data = df_z) {
  lm(reformulate(c("baseline_treatment + Usage", controls), response =paste0("post_", dv)),
       data = data)
}
```

## BH Adjustments
```{r}
dvs <- c("esi", "wb", "BPNSFS_Autonomy",
         "BPNSFS_Competence", "BPNSFS_Relatedness", "loneliness")

results <- lapply(dvs, function(dv) {
  model <- fit_primary(dv)
  co <- summary(model)$coefficients["baseline_treatment", ]

  data.frame(
    outcome = dv,
    estimate = co["Estimate"],
    p = co["Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    p_BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

results
```

## IPW Results
```{r}
# Stage 2: Completed post-study follow-up (endline completers)
m1 <- glm(
  completed_post ~ baseline_treatment + wave 
    + baseline_Age + baseline_Gender 
    + baseline_Race + baseline_EdLevel 
    + baseline_Income + Relationship + baseline_loneliness + baseline_esi + baseline_wb
    + baseline_lubben + baseline_social_satisfaction + baseline_ppl_met_inperson
    + Tenure + Usage + Social + Productivity + baseline_intensity 
    + baseline_problematic_use + log_approvals,
  data = subset(df_z, completed_endline == 1),
  family = binomial()
)


df_z$p1 <- predict(m1, newdata = df_z, type = "response")
```

```{r}
post_df_z <- subset(
  df_z,
  completed_post == 1
)

post_df_z$ipw_post <- 1 / (
  post_df_z$p1
)

summary(post_df_z$ipw_post)

fit_primary_ipw <- function(dv, data = post_df_z) {
  model <- lm(
    reformulate(
      c("baseline_treatment", paste0("baseline_", dv), controls),
      response = paste0("post_", dv)
    ),
    data = data,
    weights = ipw_post
  )

  print(summary(model))

  # HC3 robust standard errors
  print(lmtest::coeftest(
    model,
    vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC3")
  ))

  invisible(model)
}
```

```{r}

make_ipw_table <- function(
  dvs = c("esi", "wb", "BPNSFS_Autonomy", "BPNSFS_Competence", "loneliness"),
  data = post_df_z,
  file = "ipw_primary.tex"
) {
  models <- lapply(dvs, function(dv) {
    lm(
      reformulate(
        c("baseline_treatment", paste0("baseline_", dv), controls),
        response = paste0("post_", dv)
      ),
      data = data,
      weights = ipw_post
    )
  })

  # HC3 robust SEs and p-values
  robust <- lapply(models, function(m) {
    lmtest::coeftest(
      m,
      vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(m, type = "HC3")
    )
  })

  ses <- lapply(robust, function(x) x[, "Std. Error"])
  ps  <- lapply(robust, function(x) x[, "Pr(>|t|)"])

stargazer(
  models,
  type = "latex",
  out = file,
  title = "IPW-Adjusted ANCOVA of Primary Outcomes",
  dep.var.labels = c(
    "ESI", "Well-being", "Autonomy", "Competence"
  ),
  se = ses,
  p = ps,
  star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
  omit.stat = c("f", "ser"),
  notes.append = FALSE,
  digits = 3
)

  invisible(models)
}

make_ipw_table()
```

# Behavioral Data

```{r}
post_df_z <- post_df_z %>%
  filter(!is.na(post_before_timeSpentSeconds))
post_df_z$post_before_log_timeSpentSeconds <- log1p(post_df_z$post_before_timeSpentSeconds)
post_df_z$post_after_log_timeSpentSeconds <- log1p(post_df_z$post_after_timeSpentSeconds)
post_df_z$post_before_log_totalMessages <- log1p(post_df_z$post_before_totalMessages)
post_df_z$post_after_log_totalMessages <- log1p(post_df_z$post_after_totalMessages)
post_df_z$post_before_log_sessions <- log1p(post_df_z$post_before_sessions)
post_df_z$post_after_log_sessions <- log1p(post_df_z$post_after_sessions)
```

```{r}
fit_primary_behavior <- function(dv, data = post_df_z) {
  lm(reformulate(c("baseline_treatment", paste0("post_before_", dv), controls), response =paste0("post_after_", dv)),
       data = data)
}
```
